read: Publisher abstract only; batch-effect motivation and empirical-Bayes microarray context, no fulltext reproduction claimed.
adaptation: Own bounded past-anchor decoder-intercept calibration, not ComBat/Bayesian shrinkage. Source conditional slopes and temporal flow fixed. Separate positive-log intercept and detection intercept ablations with >=20 anchorpositive cells and original source support.
limitations: Atlas-challenge differences can reflect tissue/state composition or biology; adjustments cannot be labelled measured technical batch effects. 1500fixedchallengeE8.5 anchors only, no targetlearning or wholechallenge/atlas training.
